notes: Fix: Transcribe failing with "unexpected keyword argument 'metadata_errors'" on some computers. Differing PyAV versions are tolerated, only tested library versions are installed, and errors now say what to do.
Fix: a graphics-card failure in the middle of a transcription now continues on the processor instead of stopping.

Fix: after Update the button came back with no confirmation. Now: "Update installed — restart to finish" with a Restart now button, and Check for updates always says whether you have the latest version.
New: Repair components and Copy support info buttons (section 10); the System check warns about components that differ from the tested versions.
If you are on 0.9.3 or older: after this update close the black window and start the app again once; later restarts are one click.
